thought.text: The actual 960×640 "Pomodoro" window exists on the X display. Let's grab a screenshot as evidence, check data persistence, and run the repository's test suite.

reasoning_content:
The main "Pomodoro" window is 960x640 — the actual app window is being rendered on the X display. This is strong objective evidence that the GUI is running.

Next, let's confirm that data persistence is working (that settings.json / pomodoro.db are being created in ~/.local/share/Pomodoro), and if needed, run the repository's test suite (pytest) as well. I'll also verify that the window contents are being rendered — can I take a screenshot? xwd might not be installed. x11-utils includes xwd. Let's convert it… imagemagick might not be there. The window listing is probably enough, but taking a screenshot would make for better evidence. Let's try xwd and check the file size.

Also, I'll confirm that the app created the data directory. After that, I'll run pytest (the dev extras are not installed, so install pytest into the venv).

action.command: DISPLAY=:99 xwd -root -silent -out /tmp/pomodoro_shot.xwd 2>&1; ls -la /tmp/pomodoro_shot.xwd; file /tmp/pomodoro_shot.xwd 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la /root/.local/share/Pomodoro/ 2>&1; cat /root/.local/share/Pomodoro/settings.json 2>/dev/null
